mapper.update: UPDATE ebook e LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ebook_id, COUNT(1) AS doc_count, IFNULL(SUM(view_count), 0) AS view_count, IFNULL(SUM(vote_count), 0) AS vote_count FROM doc WHERE status = 'published' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM doc child WHERE child.parent = doc.id ) GROUP BY ebook_id ) d ON e.id = d.ebook_id SET e.doc_count = IFNULL(d.doc_count, 0), e.view_count = IFNULL(d.view_count, 0), e.vote_count = IFNULL(d.vote_count, 0)
